name: World Import
description: Import worlds with version compat note + unzip -o {{args}} -d world/ + write_file guard (isDangerousPath) + list_files world/.
content_html:
World Import

Version Compatibility

Worlds from 1.13+ use flattened chunk format; 1.18+ changed world height (-64 to 320) and 1.20+ added new biomes. Importing a world from a newer version into an older server can corrupt chunks. Always back up world/ before import and match server jar version to world version. This page lists world/ via list_files and unpacks zip via unzip -o {{args}} -d world/ (validated validActionArg, isDangerousPath blocks /etc etc on write_file).
